summary: An exact near-diagonal lower bound disproves the logarithmic estimate for the actual weighted cost, with a complete direct-integral repair of the required moment bound. Admissible force sets disprove the four-shear winding recipe and a two-point control case split; the projective step has a six-shear replacement, while the full general two-point replacement remains to be supplied. Isolated slips and Batchelor amplitude normalization are recorded separately, not inflated into extra findings.
